root_cause.text: In the 9p filesystem driver, `v9fs_apply_options()` incorrectly combines user-specified access mode flags with default flags using bitwise OR without clearing the existing access mask, resulting in invalid flag combinations that trigger fallback logic using an invalid UID.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement combines user-specified access mode flags with default flags using bitwise OR without first clearing the existing access mask. When user provides custom flags, they get OR'd with defaults instead of being properly replaced, creating invalid flag combinations that trigger fallback logic with invalid UID.

Similar bitwise OR operation that fails to clear existing access mode bits before applying defaults, leading to corrupted access mode values that cause the fallback mechanism to use invalid UID during filesystem mount operations.
